## INDEX.md entry

```text
- **scan-secret-files**: This file is a secret, or holds one: a private key or key store, a cloud, registry or tool credential file, Terraform state, a dotenv file with live values, or a browser credential store. Keep it out of the repository: add it to .gitignore, load the value from the environment or a secret manager, and commit a template with placeholders (.env.example) instead. Rotate any credential that was written or pushed. There is no inline waiver; a person who has reviewed a fixture commits it from their own shell. Also checked in the agent: before a write, or at the end of the turn, depending on the agent.
```
